_fiscal_year_end_note: PEP uses a 52/53-week fiscal year ending on the last Saturday of December. FY2023 ended 2023-12-30; FY2024 ended 2024-12-28; FY2025 ended 2025-12-27. The 12-27 value is a representative anchor; period-end dates per filing are authoritative.
_plausibility_note: Ranges in $millions (PEP reports all USD facts at scale=6). Used by unit_detection fallback when no explicit header phrase is found.
_stock_splits_note: No recent PEP splits. The 1996 3-for-1 is pre-iXBRL; pre-1996 filings (not in scope) use pre-split share counts.
